name: HIP 17453

planets.name: B
planets.note: Young brown dwarf companion, ~53 Mjup, L2+-1, separation ~3 arcsec (~240 AU); system age ~280+-125 Myr.

paper.title: The Companions to B and A Stars Snapshot (C-BASS) Survey: I. Discovery of a Young Brown Dwarf Companion to HIP 17453

notes: HIP 17453 A is a chemically peculiar A0V star at 80.5 pc (Gaia). HIP 17453 B is a co-moving brown-dwarf companion (~53 Mjup, L2+-1) discovered with Keck/NIRC2 over a ~10-year astrometric baseline as part of the C-BASS survey.
